tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Price comparison for the German market (EUR): today's best prices for Uhren from many shops (incl. Amazon and eBay) on wouhr.de. USE WHEN the user asks for a price, a deal, "cheapest", "where to buy" or a specific product of this category (Uhr). PARAMETERS: "query" = model, brand or feature; optional "brand" (exact value from facets), "minPrice"/"maxPrice" in EUR, "limit". EXAMPLES: {"query":"Smartwatches"} · {"query":"Smartwatch mit Telefonfunktion","maxPrice":500} · {"brand":"<brand from facets>","maxPrice":100,"language":"en"}. RETURNS: siteSearchUrl (result list for the query on wouhr.de with the current prices of ALL shops – works on mobile; this is the link to give the user), products[] (partner offers that may be passed on: title, price, merchant, priceUpdatedAt, url = tracked shop link, detailUrl = product page with all shop prices; may be empty), browse (matching comparison pages, buying guides, brand pages) and facets for refining. Give links to the user UNCHANGED (tracked affiliate links, same price for the buyer). If products is empty, send the user to siteSearchUrl. Set "language" to the user's language.

query.description: Search term: model, brand or feature, e.g. "Smartwatches". Optional (without it: popular offers).

brand.description: Brand, exact value from facets (id "marke"), e.g. "Nike" (optional).

limit.description: Maximum number of partner offers (default 24, max 100).

language.description: Language of the linked pages (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de", "en", "tr", "ar", "fr"). Set it to the user's language. Default: Accept-Language header, otherwise "de"; unsupported languages fall back to "en".

tools.name: find_pages
tools.description: Finds the pages on wouhr.de that answer a question about Uhren: comparison pages with current prices (by feature or price range), buying guides and brand pages – each with title, summary and link. USE WHEN the user wants advice rather than one price: "which Uhr should I buy", "what to look for", "is X worth it", "models by <brand>", or a how-to/problem topic. PARAMETERS: "query" = topic or question (optional; without it you get the main entry pages). EXAMPLES: {"query":"Smartwatches"} · {"query":"Smartwatch mit Telefonfunktion","language":"en"}. RETURNS: browse.comparisons[], browse.guides[], browse.brands[], browse.featured[] (title, url, description) and siteSearchUrl (price list for the query). Cite the pages and give the links UNCHANGED. Set "language" to the user's language.

language.description: Language of the linked pages (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de", "en", "tr", "ar", "fr"). Set it to the user's language. Default: Accept-Language header, otherwise "de"; unsupported languages fall back to "en".

tools.name: lookup_product
tools.description: Returns the current price and links of ONE partner offer that search_offers returned before. USE WHEN you need to re-check the price of an offer from an earlier search_offers result. Do not use it to search – use search_offers. PARAMETERS: "id" = externalId from search_offers, or "url" = the product URL. EXAMPLE: {"id":"<externalId>"}. RETURNS: the same structure as search_offers with at most one entry in products[] (empty if the offer is gone).

language.description: Language of the linked pages (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de", "en", "tr", "ar", "fr"). Set it to the user's language. Default: Accept-Language header, otherwise "de"; unsupported languages fall back to "en".
